title: Director - Service Operations
text:
As the **Director of Service Operations** at Lumos, you'll play a critical leadership role in delivering reliable fiber connectivity and an exceptional customer experience across our growing markets. You'll lead and develop regional operations teams, oversee service installations and maintenance, and drive the performance, safety, and efficiency of our field operations.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact as Lumos continues to expand, combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational expertise to strengthen service delivery, improve processes, and build high-performing teams that support our customers and continued growth.

This is a remote position supporting Service Operations across the Midwest region, with a preference for candidates located within a Lumos market in **Ohio, Indiana, or Kentucky**. Regional travel is required.

**Why Lumos:**

Lumos is transforming the future of connectivity by building one of the nation's fastest-growing 100% Fiber Optic networks. Through T-Fiber, our joint venture with T-Mobile, we're working toward a shared goal of connecting 12 to 15 million homes by 2030 while expanding access to reliable, high-speed internet in the communities we serve.

Here, you'll find more than a job, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership of your work, and help shape how we grow. We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and believe the best ideas come from people who are curious, solutions-oriented, and ready to build what's next.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead, coach, and develop regional Service Operations managers and teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and a strong customer-first culture.
* Oversee service installations, maintenance, and field operations across assigned markets, ensuring consistent quality, safety, and operational performance.
* Establish and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and customer experience metrics to drive efficiency, service reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute operational strategies that support market expansion, service delivery objectives, and long-term business growth.
* Manage department budgets, resources, and operational projects to ensure effective planning, execution, and cost management.
* Oversee vendor and contractor performance, including negotiations, service expectations, and accountability for operational results.
* Serve as a key escalation point for complex customer and operational challenges, driving timely resolution and improvements to the customer experience.
* Partner across Network Operations, Engineering, Construction, Customer Care, and other teams to improve workflows, strengthen service delivery, and support business objectives.
* Establish and maintain operational policies, procedures, and safety standards while identifying opportunities to improve processes and scale operations.

**What You'll Bring:**

* 7+ years of experience in telecommunications service operations, field operations, or a related area.
* Proven experience leading geographically dispersed teams, developing managers, and driving operational performance across multiple markets.
* Strong understanding of telecommunications service installation, maintenance, network operations, and customer service delivery.
* Experience managing operational budgets, vendor relationships, contractor performance, and service-level agreements.
* Ability to analyze KPIs, operational performance, and customer satisfaction metrics to identify trends and drive improvements.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and operational software platforms, with the ability to adapt to new systems and technologies.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the ability to work independently and lead effectively in a fast-paced environment.

**What Makes You a Great Fit:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Bachelor's degree in business, telecommunications, engineering, or a related field.
* Direct experience in the fiber broadband or FTTH industry, including distributed and centralized split network architectures.
* Knowledge of central office infrastructure, network equipment, and telecommunications facilities.
* Experience improving customer satisfaction, NPS scores, and operational efficiency across multiple markets.
* A track record of developing high-performing teams, improving operational processes, and supporting growth in a scaling organization.
* A collaborative, hands-on leadership style with the ability to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day operational execution.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Frequently operates a computer, phone, and standard office tools.
* Ability to travel to properties and regional offices as needed.
* Near-constant use of sight, speech, hearing, comprehension, and reasoning.
* Must be able to sit or remain in a stationary position for extended periods.

**Benefits & Perks:**

Our commitment to communities includes recruiting and rewarding the Lumos team members who are working together to build a brighter tomorrow.

We have:

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
* Competitive compensation packages, including bonus options for eligible positions.
* Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays.
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs).
* 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with access to professional support for life's challenges.
* 401K plan w/ up to 5% employer contribution and a self-directed brokerage option.
* Wellness program offering education and cash incentives for gym attendance and nutrition programs.
* Employee referral bonuses.
* Discounts on Lumos Fiber Internet for employees who live in our service areas.
* Discounts on T-Mobile wireless service and select features for lines.

**Applicant Eligibility Notice:** 
Applicants must be at least eighteen (18) years of age at the time of application.

**At Lumos we recruit, hire, employ, train, promote, and compensate individuals based on job-related qualifications and abilities. We have a longstanding policy of providing a work environment that respects the dignity and worth of each individual and is free from all forms of employment discrimination, including harassment, because of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals** **with disabilities or based on a sincerely held religious belief, in accordance with applicable laws.**
